prompt: Original 20-second instrumental for a tech product launch keynote reveal. Energetic, modern, upbeat, confident. 124 BPM, clear four-on-the-floor kick with crisp claps on 2 and 4, bright plucked synth arpeggio, punchy sub bass, airy pads. Structure: 0-4s sparse intro with filtered pluck and soft riser; 4-12s full beat drops in, driving and optimistic; 12-17s snare-roll build with rising white-noise sweep; 17-20s one big satisfying final hit (impact chord + cymbal) that rings out and decays cleanly. No vocals, polished, minimal, premium Apple-keynote feel.
post: ffmpeg: +5.6dB on the 0-7.78s riser, fade-out 18.6-19.8s, limiter, 160 kbps
